title: Commander Runner local configuration
description: Owner-edited, file mode 0600. This file is the ONLY source of authority: a GitHub comment can select from what is enabled here but can never widen it.

queue_issue.description: The single Issue used as the job queue.

wake_pull_request.description: Optional PR for advisory wake notices. Must differ from queue_issue. Null disables the bridge.

commander_login.description: Dispatcher GitHub login. MUST differ from executor_login.

executor_login.description: The login the runner authenticates as.

canonical_repo.description: Absolute path to the canonical clone.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path; job worktrees are created beneath it and never escape it.

state_dir.description: Absolute path for state.sqlite3, raw-output/ and artifacts/ (mode 0700).

runtime_dir.description: Absolute path for the installed runtime. MUST be outside canonical_repo and worktree_root.

provider_failover.description: Allow routing to a different provider on a transient failure.

max_attempts.description: Bounded attempt budget per job. Protocol failures never consume a second attempt.

paid_overflow_providers.description: Providers usable on PAID capacity once every free window is exhausted.

paid_overflow_authorized.description: Owner authorization for paid overflow. Inert without paid_overflow_providers.

osascript.description: Optional. Required only when notify_channel is imessage; the fixed AppleScript shipped in the runner is the only script ever run.

operational_executables.description: Absolute paths. No shell interpreter is ever used.

quality_gates.description: gate id -> list of argv arrays. 'none' must exist and be empty. Shell interpreters (sh/bash/zsh/fish/osascript/env) are refused.

delivery_path_allowlists.description: gate id -> exact repository paths a repo_delivery job may modify. No globs. Required and non-empty for any delivery job.

operation_definitions.description: Owner-only registry. The job supplies only an operation_id; the argv lives here.

argv.description: Fixed helper contract; first element an absolute executable.

allowed_target_branches.description: Owner-approved branch names, or prefixes ending in '*' (e.g. 'fix/*', 'job-*'). The job's exact SHA must be the current origin head of a bound branch. main/dev/master/HEAD/release/* are never bindable.

paid_overflow_max_cost_usd.description: Ceiling on OBSERVED paid spend in the current reset window. Providers that report credits, not dollars, contribute 0 here -- see paid_overflow_max_attempts_per_window.

paid_overflow_max_attempts_per_window.description: Window-level ceiling on paid ATTEMPTS, charged on dispatch regardless of outcome or visible price.

artifact_retention_days.description: Age after which whole artifact directories are pruned. Artifacts quote private source; the host is inside the trust boundary.

wake_destination_kind.description: legacy: historical behaviour, target not enforced. wake_bus: target must be an OPEN PR or wake posts are refused and doctor fails.

evidence_issue.description: PR B. Optional second Issue that receives every Executor record (CLAIMED, terminals, REJECTED, USER_*, CURRENT_USER_STATUS). Must differ from queue_issue and wake_pull_request. Null keeps the single-issue layout.

notify_channel.description: PR B. Owner push channel. imessage sends through Messages.app on this host via osascript.

notify_recipient.description: Phone number (optional +country) or Apple ID e-mail. Lives ONLY in this 0600 file; never read from a comment, never posted.

notify_enabled.description: Default off. Requires notify_channel != none and notify_recipient. Payload is state + short id + stop class + link; never evidence.
